concerns_addressed: DELIVERABLE 1 (auto-open with prefill on 500+): AutoErrorListener subscribes to the bus via subscribeAutoError in useEffect; on event, calls chat.open({ variant: 'autoError', prefill: { endpoint, status, errorMessage, timestamp, userAction } }). The hook's autoError variant sends a sendMessage with autoError: true, causing the server to skip the classifier and return a ready: true response with Bug type. PASS.

DELIVERABLE 2 [must-not] (no auto-submit): AutoErrorListener contains zero references to confirm() or any submit logic. The hook's autoError path initializes panelOpen: true and triggers sendMessage, but confirm() is never called — the preview screen with explicit confirm button is the only way to submit. PASS.

DELIVERABLE 3 (activeWorkspaceId null suppresses): The subscription callback checks `if (activeWorkspaceId === null) return` before calling chat.open. The render guard `if (activeWorkspaceId === null || !chat.panelOpen || chat.activeVariant !== 'autoError') return null` prevents any partial/flashing UI. Test explicitly verifies mockOpen is not called when activeWorkspaceId is null. PASS.

DELIVERABLE 4 (background/passive calls never published): Task 8's upstream tagging (only updateCard/createCard/moveCard get userInitiated: true) guarantees no background call ever publishes to this bus. AutoErrorListener relies on subscribeAutoError which only fires when publishAutoError is called. PASS.

strengths: Clean separation of concerns: AutoErrorListener is a thin wiring component that subscribes to a bus and forwards to a hook's open function — no state machine logic duplicated.
Both subscription callback and render guard check activeWorkspaceId === null, providing defense-in-depth against partial UI.
AppLayout correctly mounts <AutoErrorListener /> alongside <FloatingChatButton /> with proper import ordering.
AutoErrorListener passes the chat object as a prop to ChatPanel, allowing ChatPanel to accept an override while also maintaining its own internal fallback — good composability pattern.
autoErrorDetailToPrefill correctly maps all five bus fields (endpoint, status, message→errorMessage, timestamp, userAction) to the hook's TicketIntakePrefill shape.
Test coverage is solid: two tests covering both the happy path (bus fires → open called with correct prefill) and the null-workspace suppression path.
